name: Rope Climb
steps: Reach up to grip a securely anchored climbing rope with both hands.
Lift your knees, guide the rope under one foot and trap it against that foot with the other.
Stand against the foot lock and reach higher, alternating hands as you reset the feet.
Descend hand over hand, loosening and resetting the foot lock to control your speed.
tips: Use a secure foot wrap so your legs share the load instead of exhausting your forearms immediately.
Never slide down the rope quickly, which can cause severe friction burns on your hands and legs.
